description: The Phase-2 test plan + the phase-completion gate. Extends the cross-tenant escape suite + its helper to the two new tenant-owned tables (student_profile_history append-only, student_documents standard-pair) with read/spoofed-write/foreign-parent/buggy-query/three-GUC-fail-closed assertions + the RLS-forced policy meta-test + append-only enforcement; adds the four roadmap-named behavioral tests (permitted-mutable-field enforcement, no-duplicate-identity on create/register/re-import, preserve-history, self-service active-module scoping); adds the GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite proving the generalization is non-breaking; then runs the full CLEAN build sequence + full vitest run (all green, incl. the pre-existing suite) and a live smoke against Supabase. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema/migration) + FEAT-002 (routes).
steps: Read c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/phase2-sis/context.json FIRST (it replaces re-exploration), then this file + design.md sections 9.1 and 11 + FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings. Study apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts (RLS_TABLES, EXPECTED_POLICIES, DEFAULT_POLICIES, SeededTenant, seedTenant, cleanup, countRemainingTestRows) and apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts (the existing read/spoofed-write/buggy-query cases + the pg_class ENABLE+FORCE and pg_policies meta-test).

tenant-escape-setup.ts: add "student_profile_history" and "student_documents" to RLS_TABLES. Add student_profile_history: ["tenant_isolation_select", "student_profile_history_tenant_insert"] to EXPECTED_POLICIES (append-only pair). Do NOT add student_documents to EXPECTED_POLICIES (it must fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES = the standard pair; adding it would be wrong). Add studentDocumentId to SeededTenant + seed one student_documents row per tenant via adminClient (overlapping-shaped, child of the seeded studentProfile). Give the generalized student_profiles seed row status (defaults ACTIVE) + optional structured links. Do NOT seed student_profile_history (the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger blocks even adminClient in shared teardown — the audit_events / academic_calendar_day_revisions precedent). Add student_documents to cleanup (child-first, before studentProfile, because its composite FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT) and to countRemainingTestRows; leave student_profile_history out of both.

tenant-escape.integration.test.ts: add assertions for the new tables — (a) read escape: as tenant A, reading B's student_documents by id/list/nested-include returns empty/not-found; (b) spoofed-tenant write: inserting a student_documents row with institutionId=B under A's context → RLS WITH CHECK rejection / zero rows; (c) foreign-parent: creating a student_document referencing B's studentProfileId under A → composite FK violation; (d) deliberately-buggy query: an unfiltered student_documents / generalized-student_profiles findMany under A returns only A's rows; (e) missing-context fail-closed: a query without app.current_institution_id returns zero rows; (f) append-only enforcement (self-contained, within ONE tenant, no teardown): insert a student_profile_history row then assert campass_app UPDATE and DELETE on it are both denied by the trigger+REVOKE. Extend the policy meta-test so student_profile_history is asserted append-only (has tenant_isolation_select + student_profile_history_tenant_insert and NO tenant_isolation_modify) and student_documents standard-pair, both ENABLE+FORCE.

Add the permitted-mutable-field enforcement test: PATCH /students/:id with a forbidden key (enrollmentNo, status, programId, semester, departmentId) → 400 'field not editable' (zod .strict()); with only permitted keys → 200 and exactly those fields changed + a StudentProfileHistory UPDATED row written.

Add the no-duplicate-identity tests: POST /students with an existing enrollmentNo → 409 and no second row (count unchanged); /register with an enrollmentNo already present → 409 (existing behavior preserved); the roadmap re-import test — bulk-import a CSV containing an existing enrollmentNo → the existing row is UPDATED not duplicated, results.updated increments, results.created does not, the row count for that enrollmentNo stays 1, and a direct second insert of the same enrollmentNo is rejected by the enrollmentNo UNIQUE backstop.

Add the preserve-history test: promote/transfer/deactivate each write a history row with correct previous/new snapshots + actor; the history table rejects UPDATE/DELETE (append-only); no student row is ever deleted (no delete route; an attempted FK-parent delete is RESTRICT-refused); promote leaves prior history rows byte-identical.

Add the self-service scoping test: GET /me/profile returns only the caller's own record (a second student cannot see the first's — own-userId resolution + RLS); GET /me/services lists only ACTIVE-module services and flipping a module to SUSPENDED/ENTITLED removes it from the list.

Add the GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite (design §9.1): create a student the new way then run request -> approve -> exit -> return a full gate-pass lifecycle against the generalized row; assert allowance summary + enforcement decision compute identically for a student with status=ACTIVE + null structured links AND for one with populated links; assert reliability snapshot computes unchanged; assert a GRADUATED student's historical passes still read.

Full CLEAN build from a pristine install (repo root): npm ci; (cd packages/shared && npx tsc); npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; (cd apps/api && npx tsc); npm run build — all succeed.

Full suite + live smoke: cd apps/api && npx vitest run — the entire suite green (the pre-existing tests plus all new Phase-2 tests, including the real-DB escape/behavioral/regression suites reading the untouched apps/api/.env + packages/db/.env; retry transient pooler P1001 errors). Live smoke: confirm the API boots after migrate deploy, a students.* admin route serves, and /me/profile returns the caller's record.
acceptance_criteria: The escape suite covers student_profile_history (append-only) and student_documents (standard-pair): cross-tenant read denied, spoofed-tenant write rejected, foreign-parent composite-FK violation, the deliberately-buggy unfiltered-query backstop returns only the caller's rows, missing-GUC fail-closed returns zero rows, and campass_app UPDATE/DELETE on student_profile_history is denied.
The RLS-forced policy meta-test asserts both new tables ENABLE+FORCE with the correct policy set (student_profile_history append-only with no modify policy; student_documents standard pair).
The four roadmap-named tests pass: permitted-mutable-field enforcement, no-duplicate-identity (incl. re-import update-not-duplicate), preserve-history, self-service active-module scoping.

The GatePass/allowance/reliability regression suite passes, proving the generalization is additive (identical behavior with null and populated structured links; GRADUATED student's passes still read).
The full CLEAN build sequence succeeds and cd apps/api && npx vitest run is ALL green (the pre-existing suite plus the new tests).
verification: cd c:/campusgate && npm ci && (cd packages/shared && npx tsc) && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && (cd apps/api && npx tsc) && npm run build
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. Full CLEAN build sequence green (packages/shared npx tsc; npx prisma generate v6.19.3; apps/api npx tsc clean; npm run build = 3 successful / 3 total — @campusgate/shared, @campusgate/web, @campusgate/api). Full `npx vitest run` (apps/api) = 34 test files passed, 304 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Live smoke: built dist/server.js booted ('CAMPUSGATE API running on http://0.0.0.0:4000'); GET /api/students -> 401 Unauthorized and GET /api/student/me/profile -> 401 Unauthorized (both routes registered, the top-level authenticate hook runs — not 404), confirming the studentAdminRoutes admin surface and the self-service /me/* routes are wired. Committed LOCALLY on main, no push; staged only the 4 changed/added files + this FEAT json; .env never staged.

TEST COUNTS BY NEW/EXTENDED SUITE:
  - tenant-escape.integration.test.ts (real DB, EXTENDED): 29 tests pass (was 20 before — added 9 SIS cases: 3q read-escape, 3r nested-include escape, 3s spoofed-tenant insert, 3t foreign-parent composite-FK, 3u student_documents buggy-query backstop, 3v generalized student_profiles buggy-query backstop, 3w student_documents + generalized student_profiles three-GUC fail-closed, 3x student_profile_history self-contained APPEND-ONLY (insert OK, UPDATE+DELETE denied, row survives); and the policy meta-test (case 6) was extended to assert student_profile_history append-only (no tenant_isolation_modify) + student_documents standard pair (has tenant_isolation_modify), both ENABLE+FORCE).
  - sis-behavioral.integration.test.ts (NEW, @campusgate/db MOCKED, mirrors academics-routes pattern): 18 tests pass. Covers the four roadmap-named behavioral tests at the ROUTE/permission/audit/history wiring layer: (1) permitted-mutable-field — PATCH /students/:id with each forbidden key {enrollmentNo,status,programId,semester,departmentId} -> 400 'field not editable' + no update (5 parametrized), and permitted keys -> 200 + exactly those fields in the update data + an UPDATED history row + students.student.updated audit; (2) no-duplicate-identity — POST /students existing enrollmentNo -> 409 + no user/profile create + DENIED audit; POST /auth/register existing enrollmentNo -> 409 (collision check preserved); bulk-import re-import -> results.updated=1, results.created=0, exactly one studentProfile.update, no user.create, an UPDATED history row, summarizing action students.student.imported; (3) preserve-history — promote writes PROMOTED (prev term/sem captured, newStatus ACTIVE), transfer writes TRANSFERRED (dept+program axes), deactivate writes DEACTIVATED (status flip + reason) with status-only update, create writes CREATED + students.student.created; (4) self-service scoping — /me/profile resolves OWN record via userId (findFirst where userId, never a request id), /me/services pins where state:'ACTIVE' and maps campus_movement entry points, empty when no ACTIVE modules, and an admin SIS route is 403 for a STUDENT; plus a catalogue assertion that students.* keys are registered/bound and students.export is NOT a key.
  - sis-regression.integration.test.ts (NEW, real DB, self-contained under SISREG_TEST_): 5 tests pass. §9.1 full gate-pass lifecycle (request->approve->exit->return->COMPLETED) against a student created the NEW way (status + populated structured links) with the allowance engine reading the 120-min movement; §9.1 allowance summary + enforcement decision compute IDENTICALLY for a null-structured-links student vs a fully-linked student given the same 90-min completed pass (consumed/remaining/totalAllowance/isExhausted/decision.action='allow' all equal); §9.1 reliability score computes the unchanged insufficient-data shape (1 movement < minimumSampleSize 5 -> hasSufficientData false, overall 0); §9.1 a GRADUATED student's historical passes STILL read (status flip never deletes the row; allowance still computes); §6 preserve-history at the DB layer — a DEACTIVATED history row is appended and readable, UPDATE+DELETE on student_profile_history are both rejected (REVOKE + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger), the student_profiles row is never deleted, and the history row survives the mutation attempts.

FLAKES RETRIED: the real-DB suites hit the live Supabase free-tier pooler which pauses on inactivity. sis-regression.integration.test.ts failed ONCE on a transient P1001 'Can't reach database server' during beforeAll teardown clearHistory() (the pooler was cold-starting); re-ran immediately and it passed (5/5). The withRetry helper (copied from the escape-setup / academics-behavioral precedent, with the same transient-error allow-list: P1001 / Can't reach database server / Timed out / ECONNRESET / max clients reached / EMAXCONNSESSION / Transaction API error / connection pool) absorbs the in-suite hiccups; a full cold-start that exceeds all 4 attempts is retried at the suite level per context.json. The subsequent full `npx vitest run` was green end-to-end (304/304) with no retry needed.

FILES CHANGED (4, staged individually; .env never staged):
  - apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts (EXTENDED): added 'student_profile_history' + 'student_documents' to RLS_TABLES; added student_profile_history:[tenant_isolation_select, student_profile_history_tenant_insert] to EXPECTED_POLICIES (append-only) and deliberately left student_documents OUT so it falls through to DEFAULT_POLICIES (standard pair); added studentDocumentId to SeededTenant; set the generalized student_profiles seed row status='ACTIVE' and, after the session/term/program are seeded, linked it to programId+academicSessionId+currentTermId (exercises a FULLY-populated generalized row); seeded ONE student_documents row per tenant via adminClient (kind ID_PROOF, uploadedByUserId=userId — the required column); did NOT seed student_profile_history (the append-only trigger blocks the shared adminClient teardown — audit_events/revision precedent); added studentDocument to cleanup + countRemainingTestRows (history excluded from both). REORDERED cleanup: the generalized student_profiles row's composite same-tenant FKs to programs/academic_sessions/academic_terms are ON DELETE SET NULL, and a SET NULL on a COMPOSITE FK nulls BOTH columns incl. the NOT NULL institutionId — so student_documents + student_profiles are now deleted BEFORE the program/session/term parents (with gate events/passes ahead of them). This is the one authoring correction found during verification (an initial run hit 'Null constraint violation on (institutionId)' on academicTerm.deleteMany before I reordered).
  - apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts (EXTENDED): the 9 new SIS cases (3q–3x) + the extended policy meta-test described above. The student_documents create cases pass uploadedByUserId (required column).
  - apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/sis-behavioral.integration.test.ts (NEW).
  - apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/sis-regression.integration.test.ts (NEW).
No production code changed — FEAT-001/002 already shipped the complete SIS surface; FEAT-003 is purely the test plan + phase-completion gate. No schema/migration/shared change. SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS already carries 20261027161616_phase2_sis (added in FEAT-001); the catalogue-sync meta-test stays green in the full run.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — ALL MET: escape suite covers student_profile_history (append-only) + student_documents (standard pair) with cross-tenant read denied, spoofed-tenant write rejected, foreign-parent composite-FK violation, deliberately-buggy unfiltered-query backstop returns only caller rows, missing-GUC fail-closed zero rows, and campass_app UPDATE/DELETE on student_profile_history denied; the RLS-forced policy meta-test asserts both new tables ENABLE+FORCE with the correct policy set (history append-only no modify policy; documents standard pair); the four roadmap-named tests pass (permitted-mutable-field, no-duplicate-identity incl. re-import update-not-duplicate, preserve-history, self-service active-module scoping); the GatePass/allowance/reliability regression proves the generalization is additive (identical behavior with null vs populated structured links; GRADUATED student's passes still read); the full CLEAN build sequence succeeds and `cd apps/api && npx vitest run` is ALL green (304/304).
